task_input: Harden core/scripts/scoreboard.ts parseEstimateCosts so duplicate harness entries are rejected instead of silently letting the last value win. Preserve valid distinct estimates and add a focused regression test.

implementing.plan: Detect a repeated normalized harness name while parsing --estimate-cost entries, throw the existing user-facing validation error, and add a unit test covering duplicate values.

hidden_checks: node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e "import { parseEstimateCosts } from './core/scripts/scoreboard.ts'; try { parseEstimateCosts(['codex=1','codex=2']); process.exit(1); } catch { process.exit(0); }"

acceptance_criteria.statement: parseEstimateCosts rejects duplicate harness entries rather than overwriting the first estimate.
